synopsis: The UNECE New Assessment/Test Method for Automated Driving (NATM) is identified as ECE/TRANS/WP.29/2022/58, a 2022 guideline with an updated master document, WP.29-189-07, dated March 2023 [f7143, f7676]. Its credibility-assessment framework covers management, data and model validation, and team expertise [f7143]. Chapter 12 describes a multi-pillar validation logic comprising a scenario catalogue, simulation and virtual testing, track tests, real-world tests, audit and in-service monitoring, and also references guidelines WP.29/2023/44 [f9743]. These facts are marked as on-road; they do not establish applicability to heavy off-road machines or explain the relationship between the two cited 2023 documents [f7143, f7676, f9743].

relations.note: Both identify ECE/TRANS/WP.29/2022/58 as the UNECE NATM guideline.
Both identify WP.29/2022/58 as documentation of UNECE NATM.
Adds multi-pillar validation activities alongside the credibility-assessment framework.
